supportTickets.subject: Verification of Raymond fine suiting custom cut length

messages.message: Namaste KB Fashions team, I placed order for 3.25 meters of Raymond Dark Navy suiting fabric. Can you please confirm if the extra 0.25m allowance for tailored trousers is included from the bolt?

Namaskaram Sri Rahul garu! We have physically verified your cut length on our wooden measuring table in Kalwaral store. Exactly 3.25 meters plus a 5cm complimentary artisan selvage buffer has been precision cut. Your package is sealed and ready for dispatch.

supportTickets.subject: Doorstep delivery timing for Sadasivanagar local radius

messages.message: Could you let me know if evening delivery after 6:00 PM is available for Sadasivanagar village?
Yes sir! Our local delivery assistant covers Sadasivanagar daily between 5:30 PM and 8:00 PM. We will give you a phone confirmation prior to arrival.
